name: tutor_public_profile
description: Curated public snapshot for approved tutor discovery; never contains private application fields or certificate files

profile_id.description: Public tutor application identifier used only to open this approved listing

tutor_user_id.description: Tutor account id used to assign participant-scoped lesson access; omitted from learner-facing profile responses

photo_base64.description: Bounded profile photo snapshot for an approved tutor

photo_mime_type.description: MIME type of the approved tutor photo

hourly_rate_cents.description: Approved USD hourly rate stored in cents

intro_video_url.description: Approved YouTube or Vimeo introduction link

verified_certificate_labels.description: Labels of certificates explicitly verified by an administrator, without file details

availability_json.description: Public allowlisted local weekly schedule rules and date exceptions for tutor matching

booking_schedule_json.description: Separate safe booking projection with local schedule, allowed lesson settings, and accepted UTC busy intervals only

reviews_json.description: Visible safe review text and validated public tutor replies

rating_summary_json.description: Eligible rating summary only after at least three visible reviews

is_published.description: Whether the administrator-controlled approved listing is published
